$comment: CRM app-owned synthetic fixture scenarios for the dev-only app-views/v1 preview (CAD-974). Shape: { populated: { <view-id>: [rows…] }, empty: { <view-id>: [] } }. Rows are keyed by declared view id and are NEVER part of the descriptor or the installable app/ bundle — the canonical fixtureRows validator still checks every key/value against the view's declared fields, so undeclared keys, undeclared enum values and forbidden content refuse before render. All contact addresses use the reserved example.invalid domain; every record is synthetic; no real customer data, credentials, production state or send authority exists here. The "empty" scenario exercises the renderer's empty-state path for every non-form view.
